attendance_checkout_check.name: attendance_checkout_check
attendance_checkout_check.value: ("attendance"."checked_out_at" is null and "attendance"."picked_up_by" is null) or ("attendance"."checked_out_at" is not null and "attendance"."picked_up_by" is not null)

availability_exception_time_check.name: availability_exception_time_check
availability_exception_time_check.value: ("availability_exception"."start_min" is null and "availability_exception"."end_min" is null) or ("availability_exception"."start_min" >= 0 and "availability_exception"."start_min" < "availability_exception"."end_min" and "availability_exception"."end_min" <= 1440)

message_draft_sent_at_check.name: message_draft_sent_at_check
message_draft_sent_at_check.value: ("message_draft"."status" = 'draft' and "message_draft"."sent_at" is null) or ("message_draft"."status" = 'sent' and "message_draft"."sent_at" is not null)

pending_action_resolution_check.name: pending_action_resolution_check
pending_action_resolution_check.value: ("pending_action"."status" in ('pending', 'expired') and "pending_action"."resolved_by" is null and "pending_action"."resolved_at" is null) or ("pending_action"."status" in ('executed', 'rejected') and "pending_action"."resolved_by" is not null and "pending_action"."resolved_at" is not null)
